contract.tax_note: USD nett, non-commissionable. In case of an increase in taxes or any additional taxes the hotel may add them from the date of implementation.
contract.child_policy_text: Child Policy (Maximum Up to 02 Children): Age of 0-5 Free of Charge. Age of 6-11.99: USD 30 (Per Child/Per Night on BB including Extra Bed), USD 45 (on HB including Extra Bed), USD 58 (on FB/AI including Extra Bed); USD 10 (Per Child/Per Night on BB excluding Extra Bed), USD 25 (on HB excluding Extra bed), USD 38 (on FB/AI excluding Extra Bed). (No "not applicable for triple occupancy" line on this page.) Baby cot can be provided on request - Free of Charge (Up to one cot per room).
contract.guide_policy_text: Driver Accommodation – Available. (No guide policy printed for Surf & Safari.)
contract.cancellation_text: Cancellations within 07 days of the arrival date – 100% of the value of the booking. Cancellations within 14 days of the arrival date – 50% of the value of the booking. Cancellations within 21 days of the arrival date – 25% of the value of the booking. Group bookings, more than 8 rooms, will be liable to pay 50% of the basis booked before 30 days of arrival.
contract.payment_text: Travel agents without credit facilities are required to make the relevant payment 05 days before the clients check into the hotel. Travel agents that are entitled to credit facilities should make necessary payments within one month of the departure of guests. For last minute/short notice bookings, 100% of the payment is to be made on confirmation.
contract.terms_text: JETWING SURF & SAFARI, A LUXURY RESERVE: Single Reduction – USD 20 / Triple Supplement – USD 40 (On BB); Single Reduction – USD 50 / Triple Supplement – USD 70 (On HB); Single Reduction – USD 75 / Triple Supplement – USD 95 (On FB); Single Reduction – USD 290 / Triple Supplement – USD 330 (On AI). ALL INCLUSIVE PACKAGE – 02 NIGHTS: Rate USD 800 NETT on Double Occupancy (Per Room). Inclusions: Accommodation on Full Board basis for 02 nights; Spirits, wine and beer included (Foreign/Local); Kumana National Park Safari on a shared Jeep (01-hour drive from the hotel/Transport and Entrance fees are included); Pottuvil Lagoon Safari in the evening (15-minute drive from the hotel/Transport and boat fees included); Snacks and beverages (non-alcoholic) will be provided during safaris. Single Reduction – USD 290 / Triple Supplement – USD 330 (On AI). SPECIAL OFFERS: Meal Upgrade Offer – FOC Half Board Upgrade for minimum 03 nights and above bookings (Not Applicable for the stays during Super peak and month of February). VALUE ADDITIONS (Minimum 05 nights): First minibar serving complimentary (applicable for 1 night stay); Tuk Safari to Semanikulam Lake/Rotakulam Lake (Once per stay); Floating Breakfast (Subject to availability and weather/Once per stay); Special Dining Location – Lily Pod (Once per stay). Driver Accommodation – Available. Reservations resv.surf@jetwinghotels.com, +94 63 203 0300 / +94 70 759 7742. | VALUE ADDITIONS POLICY: A maximum of 03 value adds can be used at each property. Experiences like Tours/Walks/Demonstrations etc. will be arranged in common groups depending on the occupancy for the day. F&B discounts will not be applicable for liquor & tobacco. | JETWING LUXURY RESERVES COMBO OFFER: 10% discount for guests staying at a minimum of three (03) Jetwing Luxury Reserve properties within the same tour itinerary. Combinable with Early Bird Offer (EBO) and Stay Pay Offer. Year-round offer. Not applicable during the Super Peak period and the Month of February. All the Booking vouchers should send together to apply the Combo Offer. | GUEST AMENITIES (Jetwing Luxury Reserves): Check-In Experience – selection of welcome drink (items are subject to change without prior notice): alcoholic beverages Sparkling | Red or white wine | Beer (not applicable at Jetwing Lagoon Wellness/Jetwing Lighthouse/Jetwing Wahawa Walauwa); non-alcoholic Herbal | Fruit juices | Tea | Coffee. Selection of welcome snacks: Savory | Sweet (room canapés in common area upon guest arrival at Jetwing Warwick Gardens and Jetwing Wahawa Walauwa). In-room Experience – one fully stocked complimentary mini bar per stay (items are subject to change without prior notice): alcoholic beverages (not applicable at Jetwing Lagoon Wellness) Gin – Rockland Dry Gin 180ml | Arrack – Rockland Old Arrack Original | Beer – Lion Lager Bottle 330ml; non-alcoholic King Coconut Bottle (only item available at Jetwing Lagoon Wellness); aerated drinks Sparkling – Olu Tropical Sparkling 330ml | Coca Cola | Sprite | Pelican Island Soda | Pelican Island Tonic; snacks Nuts | Dehydrated Fruits (not applicable at Jetwing Lagoon Wellness/Jetwing Lighthouse/Jetwing Wahawa Walauwa); non-alcoholic Herbal | Fruit juices | Tea | Coffee; in-room welcome canapes. Guest Relations – 24-hour personalized butler service (not applicable at Jetwing Lagoon Wellness and Jetwing Lighthouse); guest hosting with afternoon tea and snacks or cocktail hour with canapés; departure gift. | RATES: Rates are in USD and are non-commissionable. The accommodation rates are not valid for Meetings/Incentives/Conferences/Events/Exhibitions/Weddings. In case of an increase in taxes or any additional taxes, the hotel reserves the right to add such taxes to the rates from the date of implementation. Rates cannot be extended to the domestic market or any other unspecified markets. Rates should not be published as hotel only rate on the internet by you or any other 3rd party. If such case occurs, the hotel has the right to withdraw the rate with immediate effect. | CHECK-IN/CHECK-OUT: Check-in time is 14:00 and check-out time is 12:00 (noon). If an early check-in is required within 04 hours of the usual check-in time, 50% charge of the room rate will be applied. For late check-outs up to 04 hours past the original check-out time, a 50% room rate charge will apply. Late check outs past 04 hours will be charged for 100% room rate.
contract.notes: Transcribed from "Jetwing Luxury Reserves - TA Contracted Rates - Winter 2026 & 2027.pdf" (14 pages), saved to the winter RTS folder on 2 Oct 2026. Currency "USD nett (Per room/Per night)", occupancy "Double Occupancy": the printed figure is the room at double occupancy; SGL / TPL / QUAD come from the single reduction / triple / quadruple supplements in the hotel's Terms and Conditions box (every row note gives the printed DBL and the arithmetic). Market list: "Rates cannot be extended to the domestic market or any other unspecified markets" → DOM excluded. No contract date, rate code, booking window or gala dinner is printed (PDF metadata says created 18 Aug 2026 — not printed on the sheet, so contract_date is empty). Early bird / stay-pay / combo offers are entered as offers, one row per stay range so they are not listed on Super Peak / February nights; the "booked 75/45 days prior" condition is in the offer text (no field for it). Supplier code: mapped to live "Jetwing Surf" (6-9-11-10961, Arugam Bay) because the sheet places the hotel there — the AI package's "Pottuvil Lagoon Safari (15-minute drive from the hotel)", "Kumana National Park Safari (01-hour drive from the hotel)", the tuk safari to Semanikulam / Rotakulam Lake, reservations resv.surf@jetwinghotels.com and a +94 63 (Ampara district) number; its only room, "Cabana (20 Rooms)", is Jetwing Surf's only room type. NOT Jetwing Safari Camp (Yala, Jungle Cabin). The "All Inclusive Package – 02 Nights" (USD 800 nett per room for the 2-night package, double occupancy; single reduction 290 / triple supplement 330 "On AI") is NOT entered as a nightly AI rate — no per-night figure is printed; it is in extras and terms. Surf & Safari has no early bird or stay-pay offer; its special offer is the FOC half-board upgrade for 3+ nights (entered as an offer). Not in the peak payment / cancellation list → standard terms all season.
